$Comment: The Merrymaker: the title Christmas's capstone achievement (christmas_merrymaker) pays. It shows beside a player's name in menus and leaderboards once they pick it. It names no keys: title.christmas_merrymaker.name and .flavor name and describe it, and .display, whose {0} is the name, is where it sits around the name.
